collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 8-13 and an adult)

collection.description: An adult asks a child for a turn on homemade stilts: give the adult a turn, or ask for proper lessons.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has made a pair of stilts out of two long poles and can walk on them quite well. (friend) asks for a turn. (friend) is a grown-up, (friend) reasons. How hard can it be?

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: With help, (friend) climbs up and stands very tall. Then (friend.he/she) takes one step, and then a lot more steps, very fast, in a circle, unable to stop, shouting, "How do I stop?" while (subject) runs alongside shouting, "Lean back! No, the other back!" (friend) stops by stepping off, quite gently, into a pile of drying seaweed. (friend.He/she) is unhurt and delighted.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) teaches (friend.him/her) slowly and very strictly: lean, step, breathe, lean, step, breathe. (friend) wobbles a great deal. By evening (friend.he/she) can manage ten steps in a row. (subject) is the proudest teacher on Isola. The next morning, (friend) gets up early to practice in secret.
